content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-c03-3hh0rviv/report.rdl

Show data labels on the chart, but only when the value is at least 100 hours.

I turned on data labels for the `HoursBySite` chart's `OperatingHours` series, and set them to show only when the value is at least 100.

The visibility expression is `=IIf(Sum(Fields!Hours.Value) >= 100, true, false)`. I guessed the field name `Hours` because the tools here don't expose the dataset's field list. The tool reported only that `Visible` changed, so I couldn't confirm the field exists. If `Hours` isn't the real field name, the labels will fail to render or error at run time. Please check the field name in the dataset and adjust the expression if it differs.
